human_repair_overrides.content: Although T1 created Dn gene sets, run KEGG on each strain's Up genes instead. Replace the pathway outputs with these archived Up sets: 97 = {Quorum sensing; Phenazine biosynthesis; Biofilm formation - Pseudomonas aeruginosa; Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis}; 98 = {Valine, leucine and isoleucine degradation; Sulfur metabolism; Oxidative phosphorylation; Nitrogen metabolism; Butanoate metabolism}; 99 = {Sulfur metabolism; Ribosome; Riboflavin metabolism; Oxidative phosphorylation; Aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis}.
